licenseBody:
1. Open-source license
This project (OhGithubLost, "OGL") is released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0). You may freely use, study, modify and redistribute it subject to that license; the full terms are in the LICENSE file at the repository root. Under sections 15 and 16 of that license, this application is provided without warranty of any kind and its authors accept no liability for consequences of use.

2. Data-collection commitment (guaranteed by this application)
1. This application does not collect, store or upload any personal data, including but not limited to usage statistics, crash reports, device identifiers, location, contacts or photo library contents.
2. This application contains no telemetry, analytics, advertising or profiling components, and no third-party tracking SDKs.
3. Network requests are sent only to: official GitHub API and asset domains; and, once you explicitly enable an acceleration channel, the acceleration service address you selected.
4. Your GitHub access token is kept only in your device's secure storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain / desktop key service). It is always masked in the interface and in logs, and is deleted from the device when you sign out.
5. All data this application produces (cache, drafts, downloaded files, logs) exists only on your device. Uninstalling the application removes it.

3. Exception: the optional Web feature (important — please read)
1. This application also offers an **optional Web (browser) build**. That feature is **off by default** and is **not covered** by the commitments in section 2.
2. The Web build runs inside a browser and necessarily depends on the browser, the site host and network intermediaries. Those parties **may** be technically capable of logging access times, IP addresses, User-Agent strings and similar information. This application **cannot** make a "no data collection" guarantee on their behalf.
3. Therefore: **the exception in section 3 applies to you only if you actively enable the optional Web feature.** As long as you leave it off (off is the default), the data-collection commitment in section 2 applies in full.
4. Before that feature is enabled, this application will present this exception again separately and require your explicit confirmation.

4. Third-party acceleration channels
1. Acceleration channels are an **optional** feature, off by default. Once enabled, your download request URLs pass through that channel; the operator may learn those URLs and may be able to fetch the corresponding files while the signature remains valid.
2. The built-in channel is maintained by this project's developer. Custom channels are added by you; their behaviour is the responsibility of that third party, and this application makes no guarantee about them.
3. This application verifies SHA-256 digests for downloaded content wherever possible. When no digest is available, it is honestly labelled "not verified" — never falsely claimed as verified.

5. Your rights
You may at any time disable acceleration, sign out, clear the cache, or simply uninstall the application to stop all of the processing described above. You are also entitled to obtain the complete source code of this application and audit these commitments yourself.
